1  For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mayank Gupta, Ad  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ASHOK KUMAR GAUR  Order  05/11/2020 Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners were found guilty of violation of Sub-section 2(11) of Section 26 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short 'the Act, 2006)
read with Rule 2011 and as such, they were directed under Section 52 to jointly pay fine of Rs.
2,50,000/-.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioners have filed an appeal under Section 70 of the Act,
2006 before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, Jaipur.

Learned counsel submitted that after filing of the appeal on 20th February, 2020, the Appellate Authority is not having regular sitting due to COVID-19 Pandemic and as such appeal of the petitioners has not been taken up.

Learned counsel submitted that in the meanwhile, an order has again been issued on 6th October,
2020, whereby the petitioners have been directed to pay the amount of fine, failing which, necessary recovery proceedings have been initiated against them under Section 96 of the Act, 2006.
Issue notice of the writ petition as well as stay application to the respondents, returnable on 8th December, 2020.
Notices be given 'dasti', if prayed.

In the meanwhile, the respondents are restrained to effect any recovery in pursuance of the order dt.
20th February, 2020.
(ASHOK KUMAR GAUR),J Monika/Parul/30 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
